production_safety.operational_data: No production data was read, created, updated or deleted. Existing local public assets were reused.

verification.evidence: Next.js production compilation and TypeScript checks completed; all 16 static pages generated.
10/10 Chromium desktop and iPhone-sized tests passed in 15.2s; gallery, images, overflow, search, cart persistence, checkout demo, locator, malformed storage and 404.

verification.command: Visual review of artifacts/preview-desktop.png, preview-mobile.png, home-desktop.png and spread-desktop.png
verification.evidence: Actual pie images dominate the composition; desktop and mobile text is readable; spread cards and store interiors are visible.

residual_risks: Payment, backend ordering and live inventory remain unimplemented demo functionality.
Physical mobile swipe and Safari are not covered by the Chromium test suite.
Google Fonts needs network access; fallback fonts may alter wrapping.
Existing photographs and final commercial product data still need owner confirmation before production launch.
